bio: A whiff of exoticism subtly contrasts with the historic character of the Patershol district in this grand old abode. The welcoming interior sports high ceilings and works of art, without forgetting the walled courtyard - exquisite in fine weather. The dishes are visually appetising and generously presented, revealing the wide range of flavours of traditional Thai cuisine. The ingredients are fresh, steeped in rich perfumes and aromas with just the right balance of spices. A blue-chip value since 1989!...
